documentation.subject: scholar-update: no successful run in 7 days
documentation.content: The scholar-update Cloud Function has not returned HTTP 200 in the last 7 days, so neither Scheduler job (pubs-ipeirotis, pubs-foster) has updated gs://publications_scholar/. Single failed nights are expected (Google Scholar blocks some Cloud Run IPs; each job retries 3 times, 45 minutes apart), so this only fires after a full week. Check the function and Scheduler logs; see AGENTS.md in ipeirotis/scholar_update.
